headline: EPR Applications Analyst | Application Support, Ticket Triage, Testing and Workflow Review | MBBS-Trained Physician
summary: MBBS-trained physician with four years at Greenway Health, a US EHR company, supporting close to 200 client practices on their EHR: triaging issues, testing changes, configuring workflows and widgets, and training 200+ providers, nurses and medical assistants. I sat on the Patient Safety and Functional Advisory Committees, where we triaged defects and patient safety issues through release, and I turned what users reported into change requests that product teams shipped. I have also worked in a Level 1 trauma ED and a COVID ICU, so ordering, results and documentation are familiar from the clinical side. My support work has been ambulatory and vendor-side; I have not worked in Epic yet.
greenway_bullets: Supported close to 200 client practices on their EHR: took user questions and issues, troubleshot routine problems, escalated complex ones to product and engineering, and followed them through to resolution.
Documented current workflows during discovery, then configured practice-specific workflows and widgets and tested them before go-live.
Assessed change and enhancement requests for their impact on clinicians and other modules; many of the features I shaped shipped to clients.
Triaged defects and patient safety issues from detection through stage-gate release on the Patient Safety Committee, Functional Advisory Committee and Clinical Content Team.
Trained 200+ end users, including providers, nurse practitioners, nurses and medical assistants, and kept support materials current.
Clinical lead for a new AI-first EHR from Aug 2025: provider personas, workflow mapping across the visit, and React prototypes before engineering handoff.
skills: ticket triage, troubleshooting and escalation, testing and validation, routine configuration, user access requests, documentation, upgrade and enhancement support
workflow documentation and review, impact assessment, patient safety issue reporting, stage-gate release, end-user education
emergency, ICU and outpatient workflows (ordering, results, documentation); Microsoft Office; AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini), React, GitHub
thesis_html: Good EPR support means fixing the ticket and the workflow behind it.
facts: EHR support and implementation at Greenway Health
why_fit: Triaged, troubleshot and escalated EHR issues for each practice.
